description: Recent SEC EDGAR filing metadata for public companies by CIK, optionally filtered by form. Dates, accession IDs and primary-document names only. Without payment, the call returns the x402 payment requirements; retry with an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, or params._meta["x402/payment"].
